content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Minneapolis

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education—no prior work experience needed. This makes the credential ideal for Minneapolis professionals entering project management roles across healthcare, finance, technology, and other sectors. Verify your education meets PMI standards before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Project Management Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format compresses core PM knowledge into a focused schedule, allowing working professionals to earn required contact hours without disrupting your job at Target, UnitedHealth Group, Medtronic, or elsewhere in the Twin Cities.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After coursework, register with PMI and complete the CAPM application online. You will verify your education credentials and pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy's team can answer questions about the submission process to ensure your application is complete and accurate.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study guides tailored to CAPM domains. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts and build your confidence before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM is valid for three years. Renew by earning professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or professional activities. Staying current keeps your credential active and demonstrates your commitment to project management excellence to Minneapolis employers.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
